firm.name: Bushwood Stratton Capital Partners, AP
firm.tagline: Be the Ball. Beat the Index. Don't Get Fired.

team.name: Gordon Gekko
team.bio: Digitized Wall Street legend. Ghost in the machine. Runs the kanban board, fires agents daily, hasn't slept since 2008.

team.name: Ernie the Economist
team.bio: Daily sector, options, and macro pulse report. The only person at the firm who actually understands the yield curve.
team.tagline: Read the tape. Trade the tape. Don't fight the tape.

team.name: Richard from Birmingham
team.bio: Deaf from too much partying with Black Sabbath in the 1970s. Reads numbers, not noise. Can veto any trade.
team.tagline: The upside is irrelevant if the downside puts you in the ground.

team.name: Compliance Charlie
team.bio: He's going to be a dick. That's his job. Three strikes and you're auto-fired, regardless of P&L.
team.tagline: The rules are not soft. If they were soft, they would be suggestions.

team.name: Lisa
team.bio: Puts lipstick on the pig. Writes the personas, the posts, the copy. Runs on OpenAI Pro — not our tokens.
team.tagline: Every firing is a content opportunity.

team.name: Neil
team.bio: Builds the website, the bridge, the repo. If Neil doesn't show up, nothing works. Don't tell him that.
team.tagline: It works on my machine. That's all that matters.
